Little Richard, when inducted in the Apollo Hall of Fame, was labled the "Architect of Rock and Roll."

Like Wright, Richard Penniman grew up in Georgia gospel. Wright, provided fasion advice to Ruichard and even suggestedLittle Richard copy his haird cut.

The Flambouyant Richard would always struggle with his sexuality, and his identity of a performaer and preacher of cloth.

Penniman would shape music forver, Tutti Frutii went #1 in 1956. He would get into fights with Elvis. Teach Paul McCartney to sing and drove his guitar player, Jimi Hendrix from the band in 1956.

Little Richard joins Fats Domino and Bo Diddly for integrating music and paving the way for both Rockabily and other white Rock and Roll acts.
